title: Menace II Society
description:
S1 E1
In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

title: Paid in Full
description:
S1 E1
A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience.  Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

title: Four Brothers
description:
S1 E1
After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

title: Baby Boy
description:
S1 E1
Jody is a 20-year-old African American in South Central L.A. who is trying to live large but doesn't have a job. Growing up is tough on Jody, but a series of events force him to learn lessons about living, loving and surviving as a man in the hood.

title: Next Friday
description:
S1 E1
A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.
